component.name: Imladris
component.summary: WPS-style scientific polyglot studio and Markdown editor with live WebKitGTK preview

description.p: Imladris is a native Linux polyglot document studio and scientific Markdown editor built with Vala, GTK4, Libadwaita, GtkSourceView 5, and WebKitGTK 6.0. Featuring an adaptive ribbon interface inspired by modern office suites, Imladris provides a distraction-free writing environment for technical authors, data scientists, and researchers.
Whether editing Quarto research reports, R Markdown statistical documents, or Jupyter notebooks, Imladris renders mathematical formulas, tables, and charts in real time.

ul.li: Three-Tier Ribbon Interface: Contextual tabs for File, Insert, Format, Review, and AI Tools
Polyglot Format Support: Full support for standard Markdown (.md), Quarto (.qmd), R Markdown (.Rmd), and Jupyter (.ipynb)
Real-Time Live Preview: WebKitGTK 6.0 preview with KaTeX mathematics, Mermaid diagrams, and syntax highlighting
Dual AI Co-Author: In-editor writing assistant with support for local offline models and cloud LLMs
Model Context Protocol (MCP): Built-in MCP server integration for agentic document analysis and data retrieval
Git Versioning: In-app diffing, commit history, and branch management

description.p: Release v0.5.0 introduces dynamic UI morphing (GNOME Apostrophe distraction-free mode and RStudio 4-quadrant workbench), full multi-format adapters (.md, .qmd, .rmd, .ipynb), atomic crash recovery with shadow buffer caching, and 5 interactive Smart Ribbon popovers.
Release v0.4.0 with AI co-authoring assistance, polyglot auto-completion, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server integration.
Release v0.3.0 featuring WebKitGTK 6.0 live preview, KaTeX math rendering, and multi-format export.
